spec2def(dcomlaunch.dll dcomlaunch.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# dcomlaunch.dll is all Rust (dcomlaunch-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/dcomlaunch-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# dcomlaunch.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/dcomlaunch-rust/src/dcomlaunch/dcomlaunch.rs)
# network.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/dcomlaunch-rust/src/dcomlaunch/network.rs)
add_cargo_module(dcomlaunch dcomlaunch-cargo dcomlaunch.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE dcomlaunch-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS psdk)
